title: Fix deploy prerender failure on login
description: npm run deploy fails during the OpenNext export/prerender step for /login with a webpack runtime error and missing /_error manifest lookup. Investigate the login route's dynamic behavior and remove prerender/export incompatibilities so deploy builds complete successfully.
notes: Applied login-route fix: app/login/page.tsx is now force-dynamic and components/auth-panel.tsx no longer uses useSearchParams. Verified npx next build succeeds and /login is emitted as dynamic. Full OpenNext deploy-path verification is currently blocked by an unrelated concurrent package.json overwrite that removed the project scripts, causing npm run build/lint to fail inside the OpenNext CLI.

title: Fix local signup redirect MODULE_NOT_FOUND on home page
description: After registering a new local account, the redirect to / returns a server-side MODULE_NOT_FOUND error and a 500 response on the home page. Reproduce the failure, identify the missing module or import path, and fix the root page so local signup lands on the authenticated upload page successfully.

title: Investigate Cloudflare Worker CPU exceeded limits
description: Production Cloudflare Worker has reported CPU exceeded limits. Investigate current traces/logs for exceededCpu outcomes, identify the exact route and code path involved, verify whether Redis queue mode and preview-generation mitigation are active in production, and recommend or implement any remaining fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Document the route(s) and job event correlation for CPU-limit incidents; confirm production config/runtime queue mode and preview generation setting; provide next fixes or close as mitigated with evidence from Cloudflare observability.

title: Fix wrapped profile job status badge
description: Profile job status labels can wrap onto two lines in the Arabic UI, which makes active jobs render as a broken pill in the profile view. Keep the status badge on one line in the profile jobs list without changing job state semantics.

title: Fix moved thmanyahsans font import
description: Update the Next.js layout font import paths after thmanyahsans assets were moved under assets/font/thmanyahsans so the production build resolves the font files again.

title: Add profile transactions expansion
description: Bring the admin wallet show more/show less interaction to the existing /profile transactions list and remove the top profile hero container so the page opens directly into the wallet/jobs panel.

title: Add searchable admin wallet user picker
description: Replace the manual email entry in the admin wallet adjustment panel with a searchable dropdown powered by Magic UI Animated List, using the existing wallet summaries dataset.

title: Remove admin hero container
description: The admin page should no longer render the top hero container with the Arabic eyebrow text 'أرشيف الإدارة'. Remove that container while keeping the stats cards and remaining admin content intact.

title: Reset homepage upload after terminal job state
description: Homepage upload flow keeps the inline 100% progress and download button mounted after a generation reaches a terminal state. Reset the frontpage uploader after completed, failed, cancelled, expired, or result download failure states, and direct users to the profile page for previous job details and downloads.

title: Allow admin wallet deductions
description: Admin wallet adjustments currently only accept positive credit grants. Update the admin wallet flow to allow negative adjustments while rejecting deductions that would push a user's balance below zero. Cover validation, API behavior, admin UI copy/input handling, and wallet tests.

title: Admin wallet recent transactions
description: The admin users list currently shows full wallet activity per user. Update it to show only the two most recent transactions by default with a show-more affordance for additional history.

title: Switch UI numerals to Latin digits
description: Arabic copy should stay as-is, but all runtime-rendered numbers, dates, and times in the app should use Latin digits instead of Arabic-Indic digits. Update shared locale helpers and direct numeric formatting call sites in the UI.

title: Remove Alisa sample asset
description: Remove the Alisa sample entirely from the app, including marquee content, sample allowlists, tests, docs, and bundled preview assets so no broken sample references remain.

title: Reject default admin seed password
description: The local admin seed script should fail when the default placeholder admin seed password is still configured, because that currently creates a real account with an unintended credential and confuses local login.
close_reason: Seed script now rejects the default placeholder admin password so local login setup is less error-prone.

title: Make mock Hi3D runs configurable
description: Add an environment-controlled mock Hi3D duration so local testing can keep generation jobs active for around one minute without spending real Ab3ad3d tokens.
close_reason: Added configurable mock Hi3D duration and matching poll cadence for long-running local upload tests.
